goal: Fold the production-risk assessment into the first governed review: a head-bound (schema v2) pre-merge risk request on open PRs, v1/v2 acceptance in the proof with ancestry and blob-identity re-proved at apply, workflow fallback wiring, adversarial tests, and the procedure doc.
prohibited_actions: Do not weaken the durable-APPROVE, digest, or substantive-assessment requirements.
Do not accept a v2 block without the ancestry and blob-identity re-proof.
Do not touch migrations or database objects.
assumptions: The v2 binding (PR head ancestor of promoted main, migration blobs identical) is as strong as the v1 merged-head binding.
